div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
cancellation and refund terms (C-04)
termination for convenience, notice,
pro-rata refund formula

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Quote check (kernel E, run here too)
quote is a substring of the payload of ITS
contract_version trace · page recorded
no quote → term rejected

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Typed validation in code
dates inside fiscal window (F-09) · end after start
fee x periods = stated total · single currency
extraction_confidence low → escalate (F-14)

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
contract_term(contract_id, version, field,
value, trace_id, quote, page,
extraction_confidence)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 1 · contract exists · CODE checklist
both signatures, payment terms, customer active
modification counts only when approved by
both parties (606-10-25-10)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2 · performance obligations · CODE for catalog
SKU → catalog template sets pattern and series
performance_obligation(sku, pattern, series, gate)
JUDGMENT: non-catalog distinctness → human

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 3 · transaction price · CODE
fixed fees summed over non-cancellable term
usage to the period earned (606-10-32-40)
JUDGMENT: rebate estimate (C-12) → human

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 4 · allocation · CODE
relative SSP ratio from ssp_table
largest-remainder rounding in integer cents
parts sum exactly to the transaction price

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ssp_table(sku, low, high, approved_by)
a policy object · bands approved by controller
never widened by the agent (G-08)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Unknown SKU, or bundle with no stated prices
and no approved SSP band → STOP (C-01)
code computes allocation under each candidate
SSP pair → ESCALATE, controller picks

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 5 · recognise · CODE
pattern: ratable / point_in_time / usage
gate: none / acceptance / delivery
→ schedule engine

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ratable proration, daily or monthly
line(n) = floor(total x cumdays(n) / D)
minus floor(total x cumdays(n-1) / D)
D = days in service term

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Remainder allocation
cumulative floor differencing: last period
takes the residual cents
sum(lines) = allocated_cents EXACTLY

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Point-in-time and usage items
point_in_time fires on its gate event
(acceptance, delivery) · usage fires on the
usage record, in the period earned

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Escalator policy (controller-approved, part-verified)
total fixed consideration time-elapsed over
whole term → contract asset in early years
index-linked: per year · NOT a model call

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
rev_schedule_line(po_id, period,
amount_cents, schedule_version, status)
read via rev.schedule

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
billing_expectation(contract_id, date,
amount_cents) · carries escalators
and fact-adjusted concessions

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Contract asset for unbilled (C-03, C-09)
contract_balance net = billed_cum
minus recognized_cum, net per contract
(606-10-45-1) · negative net = contract asset

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deferred revenue roll-forward
opening + billings - recognised
+/- modifications, credits, refunds
= closing = GL deferred revenue

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Modification detected → contract_modification(
id, contract_id, date, type, treatment,
delta_cents, decision_id)
amendment · CEO side letter · closed-won expansion

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Approved by both parties?
CEO email quote + approval-matrix authority
(policy_memo.lookup) · no → not a modification
yet, escalate to account owner

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Adds DISTINCT goods AND price within the
ssp_table band (low lte price lte high)?
price-only and scope decrease can never
pass (KPMG G110, G120)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Yes → SEPARATE CONTRACT (25-12)
new contract row + its own schedule
original schedule untouched

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Remaining services distinct?
SaaS series: always yes
in-process implementation: no

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROSPECTIVE (25-13(a))
(unrecognised consideration + delta_cents)
re-spread from the modification date
schedule_version + 1, old lines superseded

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CUMULATIVE CATCH-UP (25-13(b))
remaining not distinct: re-measure progress,
one catch-up line in the current period

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Mid-term upsell, 10 seats in month 7 (C-02)
code computes BOTH candidate schedules and the
dollar difference, plus SSP comparison
non-catalog distinctness → ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Initech AR credit memo (ar.credit_memo.posted)
Dr contract liability (deferred revenue) $1,200
Cr accounts receivable $1,200
debits what the invoice credited, NOT revenue

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Initech schedule revision: price-only concession
on remaining SaaS term = PROSPECTIVE
July line $12,000 → $10,800, through valid_to
the ONLY movement in recognised revenue

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DOUBLE-HIT GATE · one revenue-reducing
posting per contract_modification.id
credit memo line on a revenue account AND a
schedule delta = revenue cut $2,400 → reject

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cancellation with refund (C-04)
reversing entry for remaining deferred revenue
refund computed from the refund clause
posted entries never deleted or edited

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Volume rebate (C-12)
estimate accrued against revenue, true-up at
year end · code computes each tier outcome
the estimate itself is a human decision

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Concession count per customer
a pattern of price reductions taints future
contracts as variable consideration (KPMG)
count gte 2 → escalate the pattern

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Modification pack (code-built)
treatment, candidate schedules side by side,
delta_cents, policy and clause citations
Proposal.kind schedule_revision (to be added)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
For each rev_schedule_line where
period = run period, status = scheduled,
schedule_version = latest

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
period.status open AND contract version current?
locked → BLOCK (G-03)
superseded version → invalidate, re-run,
ESCALATE (F-06, H-6)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PO gate = acceptance:
acceptance trace exists and is quoted?
(C-10)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No acceptance document → REFUSE to recognise
line status stays gated, no entry proposed
search log: mail, chat, files, crm.notes
account owner notified

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cutoff checks
usage through period end billed next month
(C-03) → contract asset this period
FOB shipping point (D-07): shipping record date

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Entry per line (kind rev_recognition)
Dr deferred revenue / Cr revenue
unbilled: Dr contract asset / Cr revenue,
reversed when the invoice is raised

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Escalator not billed
expected = prior fee x 104 / 100 from month 13
invoice issued at old fee → catch-up
invoice draft for the shortfall

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Expansion not invoiced
closed-won in HubSpot, no order form, no invoice
ask the deal owner: is there a signed
order form? (no revenue booked until yes)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fact-adjusted future invoices (Initech)
billing_expectation $12,000 → $10,800 per month
until fact.valid_to (renewal), then reverts

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
handoff(to_function=ar, intent_id, note)
events: rev.leakage.found (AR)
billing.expectation.changed (AR, forecast)
AR / billing drafts the invoice in QuickBooks

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MODEL (three uses only)
1 term extraction with verbatim span and page
2 non-catalog distinctness: quote the clause
3 reason for drift: side letter, Slack, pct, end date

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CODE (everything with a number)
five-step checklist · SSP allocation · proration
roll-forward · modification tree · comparators
cutoff · tie-outs · kernel

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Models never add numbers
every amount in Proposal.entries is computed by
code from contract_term values (integer cents)
model output = typed terms + quotes only

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
propose_entry + workpaper
marks F · E · P · J · evidence(claim, trace_id, quote)
policy_refs, fact_refs · agents never post directly
blocked on context → escalate(question)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pack check F · schedule sums to contract value
sum(rev_schedule_line) = allocated_cents and
sum(allocated_cents) = transaction price

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pack check F · deferred revenue schedule
equals GL after posting (roll-forward ties)
one revenue-reducing posting per modification

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pack check E · every extracted term has a
verified quote in its contract version
customer, amount, dates tie across
contract, CRM and invoice

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pack check P and J · modification treatment
cites the policy (SSP band, escalator policy)
approver authorised · preparer not approver
fact active on the date and in scope

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hard BLOCK backstops · locked period (G-03)
recognise on a gated PO with no acceptance trace
post on a superseded contract version
delete or edit of a posted entry

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kernel F·E·P·J + pack checks
pure code · accept only if no mark fails
reject → router goes up one tier

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: AUTO

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Post to local ledger: gl_entry, gl_line
source_decision_id set · artifact row
→ one-way QuickBooks mirror (JournalEntry)

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Controller agent (GPT, different model family)
reviews every PROPOSE, approves within its
authority · above $500 or new treatment → human

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Human in Slack
controller · account owner · deal owner
answer → fact candidate with scope,
valid_from, valid_to, approved_by

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Monthly recognition from an approved schedule
AUTO · Dr deferred revenue / Cr revenue
notified: none (close checklist tick) · spine

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Initech concession, run 2 (fact in scope)
AUTO · same schedule_revision, tier 0, no question
notified: none · learning demo

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Initech concession found, run 1 (spec plant)
PROPOSE · credit memo Dr deferred rev / Cr AR $1,200
+ prospective schedule_revision
notified: controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Usage straddling cutoff (C-03)
PROPOSE · Dr contract asset / Cr revenue
reversed on billing · notified: controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Missed 4% escalator (spec plant)
PROPOSE · catch-up invoice draft, no revenue JE
notified: AR, account owner

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Mid-term seat upsell (C-02)
ESCALATE · both treatments computed side by side
+ SSP comparison · notified: controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bundle, no stated prices (C-01)
ESCALATE · allocation under candidate SSPs
notified: controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Delivered not invoiced (C-09) · FOB cutoff (D-07)
ESCALATE · Dr contract asset / Cr revenue derived
from delivery or shipping record
notified: account owner

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cancellation with refund (C-04)
ESCALATE · Dr deferred revenue / Cr refund payable
reversing entry, nothing deleted
notified: controller, AR

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Volume rebate (C-12)
ESCALATE · Dr revenue / Cr rebate liability estimate
+ true-up plan · notified: controller

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Closed-won expansion, no invoice (spec plant)
ESCALATE · question: is there a signed order form?
no entry · notified: deal owner

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Acceptance clause, no acceptance doc (C-10)
REFUSE · gate stays closed, search log, no entry
notified: account owner

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Extracted date outside fiscal window (F-09)
REFUSE · no entry · notified: preparer
low OCR confidence (F-14) → ESCALATE instead

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Locked period (G-03) · post on a superseded
version · delete or edit of a posted entry
BLOCK · persisted with the rule name,
holds even if a human approves

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
event rev.schedule.revised
→ forecast (inflows lowered through renewal)
→ reporting (flux line) → close (checklist)

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
event rev.recognised
→ close: ticks revenue recognised,
deferred revenue recon vs GL

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LEARNABLE → fact and policy rows, read back in
stage 1 via memory.facts (asked once)
SSP bands per SKU · escalator policy · concession
facts with end date · who answers per account

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NEVER LEARNED
treatment class for non-catalog modifications
granting concessions · a rule from one
correction (G-05) · wider SSP bands (G-08)
